custom_checks.name: full_outer_row_count_reconciles
custom_checks.sql: WITH expected_dcm AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.master_stg.data_model_v3` WHERE qa_v3_source_detail_type = 'dcm' AND _date BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(date) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.master_stg.rtl_cm360_direct_conversions_history_qa`) AND (SELECT MAX(date) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.master_stg.rtl_cm360_direct_conversions_history_qa`)), unmatched_conversions AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.master_stg.rtl_cm360_conversion_metrics_history_qa` AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.master_stg.data_model_v3` AS d WHERE d.qa_v3_source_detail_type = 'dcm' AND d._date = c.conversion_date AND LOWER(TRIM(d._package_id)) = LOWER(TRIM(c.package_id)) AND LOWER(TRIM(d._placement_id)) = LOWER(TRIM(c.placement_id)) AND LOWER(TRIM(d._creative_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(c.creative)))), candidate AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM {table}) SELECT ABS((SELECT record_count FROM candidate) - ((SELECT record_count FROM expected_dcm) + (SELECT record_count FROM unmatched_conversions))) AS value

custom_checks.name: dcm_impressions_preserved
custom_checks.sql: SELECT ABS(COALESCE(SUM(dcm_impressions), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(dcm_impressions) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.master_stg.data_model_v3` WHERE qa_v3_source_detail_type = 'dcm' AND _date BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(date) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.master_stg.rtl_cm360_direct_conversions_history_qa`) AND (SELECT MAX(date) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.master_stg.rtl_cm360_direct_conversions_history_qa`)), 0)) AS value FROM {table}

custom_checks.name: all_direct_conversion_totals_preserved
custom_checks.sql: SELECT ABS(COALESCE(SUM(cm360_conv_total_conversions), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_conversions) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.master_stg.rtl_cm360_direct_conversions_history_qa`), 0)) AS value FROM {table}
